prompt:
Build a three-phase shunt STATCOM for a 50 Hz system. A three-phase grid and load must share a common PCC, and a controllable two-level voltage-source converter with a physical DC-link capacitor must connect in shunt at that PCC through one coupling reactor per phase. Read Vsrc_LL, P_load and Q_load from base-workspace variables; their nominal values are 190.53 V, 1000 W and 5000 var, and each operates over a +/-10% envelope. The measured DC-link voltage must remain near 399 V as these inputs vary, and the physical converter current must compensate the reactive component of the load current and respond in the appropriate direction when Q_load changes. The DC-link regulation and reactive compensation must establish promptly after startup. Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries Vdc, Vpcc, Icomp, Igrid and Iload. Vpcc must be one physically measured PCC phase voltage; Icomp, Igrid and Iload must each contain exactly the three physically measured phase currents. Use the same phase ordering for Icomp, Igrid and Iload; Vpcc must be the PCC phase voltage corresponding to channel 1 of those three current signals. Define positive current from grid to PCC for Igrid, from PCC to load for Iload, and from PCC to converter for Icomp, so Igrid - Iload - Icomp must remain approximately zero at the PCC.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XELEC08.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
